pedagogy_adversarial_sample.finding: Phase 5 mechanically graded bullet-rich items as Grade A. Adversarial review shows ~20% of Grade A items lack beginner context or acronym explanations, warranting Grade B.

rapid_recall_forensics.finding: Phase 5's claim of 0 'too long' recall units was an artifact of simple char-length checking. When tested for cognitive load (>3 numbers), 42 units are overloaded.
